content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the incorrect placement of memory barriers in the code, which allowed the Alpha architecture to reorder I/O accesses. Specifically, the changes made in previous commits moved memory barriers after write operations instead of before them, leading to a situation where there was no barrier between an I/O write followed by an I/O read. This lack of a barrier caused hangs on the Alpha Avanti platform when interacting with devices like the serial port and real-time clock, as the architecture's reordering could lead to inconsistent or unexpected behavior. The patch reinstated the necessary memory barriers to ensure proper ordering of I/O operations as per the architecture's specifications.
